titles.romaji: Majokko Tsukune Chan: Tsuki to Hoshi no Uta
titles.native: 魔女っ娘つくねちゃん 月と星のうた

description:
Hiroaki Magari the author of "Majokko Tsukune-chan", personally produces an animation of the latest story! The lyrics are also made by him. And singing is Haruko Momoi who voiced Tsukune-chan.

(Source: KODANSHA's official YouTube channel)
